text.description_html:
AHI SIG412-630 Contemporary Square Stainless Steel Door Pull

This very contemporary designed door pull is made of stainless steel by AHI Hardware, a leader in stainless door hardware. Warm Satin Stainless Steel finish for a truly eye catching design.

Specifications for AHI SIG412 Contemporary Door Pull

  • Total Height: 235 mm (9.25")
  • Mounting Centers: 210 mm (8.25") C/C
  • Projection: 63 mm (2.48")
  • Diameter: 16 mm (.63") Square
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel

Packaged Standard Back to Back mounting. (Pulls bolt to each other).

*Sold as a pair.
